constraintRules.text: Compensation Review is not a root; WM-REC-010 owns authoritative review outcomes.
WM-ECO-031 owns payroll calculation and payslip faces, not source term authority.
WM-ECO-009 owns payment instruction, execution and settlement; net pay and payslip do not prove settlement.
Statutory filing or remittance submission does not prove authority acceptance; remittance, net-pay settlement and benefit claim remain distinct.
WM-ECO-031 reads assignment versions and enrollment snapshots; neither candidate depends on a payroll result.
Aggregates and WM-MAT-008 pay-gap observations are WM-XCT-003 projections and never root attributes.
Every released projection carries a mandatory cohort-floor reference and declared grain, measure, period and provenance.
Complementary suppression applies across overlapping cohorts and repeated queries; releases that isolate a person by difference are refused.
Join keys capable of reconstructing person-level pay are withheld and release-set linkability is declared.
Empty, refused and suppressed responses are externally indistinguishable while the internal audit preserves the governed reason.
Suppression uses recorded authority and emits provenance to the access-audit boundary; no numeric threshold, noise or query budget is invented.
Seat-level and derived per-person range observations follow the same disclosure controls as aggregates.
Every amount pins currency, basis, period, frequency, FTE normalization and source authority.
WM-MAT-008 remains placement-cautioned and cannot bypass WM-XCT-003 disclosure controls.
